name: no_pr_recorded_discovers_merged_pr_by_branch
description: No PR was ever recorded for the task (no pr=, no pr_head=; e.g. a yolo merge on a repo without PR CI). The guard must discover PR 7 from the task branch name: it reads MERGED with a head that is a no-mistakes auto-fix commit on top of the local HEAD. The squash landed feature.txt on origin/main under a new SHA and the head branch was never pushed/was deleted. Allowed, and the guard must surface the discovered PR URL (Firstmate asserts the resolved URL is recorded on completion).
